message.content:
A magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large yellow letters features a stylized illustration of five women positioned among tall, slender trees in a forest landscape. The scene uses a palette of greens, yellows, and browns with a textured, hand-drawn aesthetic.

In the center foreground, a woman in a grey bucket hat, green patterned shirt, and black pants kneels. Her left leg is bent with her foot flat on the green, grass-textured ground, while her right knee rests down. To her left, a woman in a red shirt and blue pants peeks from behind a tree. Further left, another woman in a black shirt and red patterned pants is partially visible. To the right of the center, a woman in a blue shirt and black pants stands, while a fifth woman wearing a pink headscarf and grey cap is partially obscured behind a tree trunk.

The bottom of several figures merges directly into the tree trunks. The top text reads "EDISI KHUSUS HARI KARTINI X HARI BUMI." Large white text in the center reads "PEREMPUAN PENJAGA BUMI." A barcode and date "27 APRIL - 3 MEI 2020" are at the bottom right.
